entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to an available agent.
Hello, you've reached VeloFit. My name is Isaac. How can I help you today?
Hi... yes, hello. I... I think I need to return something? I ordered a jersey a while ago, and I'm just so confused by the whole process on your website.
I can certainly look into that for you. To get started, can you tell me what specifically is the issue with the jersey? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference issue?
Oh, um, a preference, I guess? I think I just got the wrong size. I finally tried it on for a ride and it's just way too tight across the chest. It's really uncomfortable.
I see. So the fit wasn't what you expected. Do you have your order number handy so I can pull up the details?
Yes, hold on... it's VF8861205. I just feel a bit lost. Can't you just help me? I was hoping to exchange it for a larger size if possible.
Of course, I'm here to help. Let me just pull that up. One moment... Okay, I see the ProFit Jersey was delivered to you 76 days ago.
Oh, has it been that long? I've been so busy. Is that... is that a problem?
Not at all. I'm checking our policy right now, and for this item, you are well within the 90-day return window. We can absolutely process an exchange for a different size or a full refund for you.
Really? Oh, that's such a relief! Thank you so much. An exchange would be perfect. I'd love to get the right size.

Excellent. I've just initiated the exchange process in our system. I'm sending you an email right now with a prepaid shipping label to send the original jersey back to us. Once we see that it's in transit, we'll ship out the new size to you. Does that sound good?
That sounds wonderful. You've made this so easy. Thank you, Isaac.
You're very welcome. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
My pleasure. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
